pages.title: Consent Management
pages._note: Consent objects are fetched from filinq's own PHP controller (not a plain OR index endpoint) and rendered via CnIndexPage with custom column formatters; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Consent Detail
pages._note: Detail fetched via consent store; sidebar driven by navigationStore.selected. Uses custom layout; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Publish never
pages._note: Entity-level publish-never rules (publicationProhibition) via PolicyController (indexProhibitions/createProhibition/showProhibition/updateProhibition/deleteProhibition) + PolicyMatchService. Reachable from the menu as "Publish never", beside Consent Management. It carried no menu entry until 2026-09-06: publication-policy-labels-and-nav was ticked complete, but its navigation tasks edited MainMenu.vue, which no longer exists since the app moved to manifest-driven nav (ADR-037), so only the label half of that change survived and the page was reachable by hand-typed URL alone. The page is PolicyRuleIndex with config.surface prohibition; its form is PolicyRuleFormModal with surface prohibition, its own file per ADR-004.

pages.title: Publish always
pages._note: Entity-level publish-always rules (publicationStandingConsent) via StandingConsentController (index/create/show/update/destroy) + PolicyRetroactiveService. Reachable from the menu as "Publish always", beside Consent Management — see the Prohibitions note for why it had no entry until 2026-09-06. The page is PolicyRuleIndex with config.surface standingConsent; its form is PolicyRuleFormModal with surface standingConsent, its own file per ADR-004 (the hydra modal-isolation gate).
